description: This file is a self-test for stack walking in the Breakpad processor, specifically testing stack frame counting and register access on different architectures (x86, PPC, SPARC). It includes platform-specific inline assembly to retrieve register states and performs recursive stack frame analysis.

classes.name: SelfMemoryRegion
classes.description: A MemoryRegion subclass providing direct access to process memory for stack walking.

methods.name: GetEBP
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the EBP register on x86 architecture.

methods.name: GetESP
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the ESP register on x86 architecture.

methods.name: GetEIP
methods.description: Retrieves the instruction pointer on x86 architecture.

methods.name: GetSP
methods.description: Retrieves the stack pointer on PPC and SPARC architectures.

methods.name: GetPC
methods.description: Retrieves the program counter on PPC and SPARC architectures.

methods.name: GetFP
methods.description: Retrieves the frame pointer on SPARC architecture.

methods.name: CountCallerFrames
methods.description: Counts the number of stack frames beneath the caller function.

methods.name: Recursor
methods.description: Recursively verifies stack frame counts to test stack walking.
